title: Locate and Identify Settings Header Component
description: Find the React component that renders the Settings page header and identify the current styling implementation
details: Navigate to the app/dashboard/page.tsx file (or related settings component) and locate the JSX element that renders the 'Settings' header text. This is likely an <h1> element with Tailwind CSS classes. Document the current classes being used (e.g., text-4xl, font-bold) and verify if this is a standalone component or part of a reusable header component that might affect other pages.
test_strategy: Manual inspection of the codebase to locate the correct file and element. Verify the current visual appearance in the browser to establish a baseline for comparison.

title: Modify Header Styling Classes
description: Update the Tailwind CSS classes on the Settings header to reduce its visual prominence
details: Replace the existing size and weight classes with smaller alternatives. For example, change text-4xl to text-3xl or text-2xl, and consider reducing font-bold to font-semibold or font-medium. Ensure the new classes follow the project's typography scale defined in tailwind.config.js. If the header is part of a reusable component, consider adding a size prop or conditional className to scope the change only to the Settings page.
test_strategy: Visual verification in local development environment across different screen sizes (mobile, tablet, desktop). Compare before and after screenshots to ensure the header is noticeably smaller while maintaining readability and proper visual hierarchy.

title: Validate Responsive Design and Accessibility
description: Ensure the modified header maintains proper responsive behavior and accessibility standards
details: Test the new header styling across all standard Tailwind breakpoints (sm, md, lg, xl) to ensure it remains appropriately sized on all devices. Verify that the semantic HTML structure is preserved (header should remain an <h1> for SEO and accessibility). Check that the visual hierarchy is maintained - the header should still clearly function as a page title relative to other text elements. Ensure sufficient color contrast is maintained with the new styling.
test_strategy: Manual testing across different viewport sizes using browser dev tools. Run accessibility checks to verify heading structure and contrast ratios. Test with screen readers if available to ensure the header is still properly announced as a page title.
